## Create Index
PUT favourite_candy

## Create Doc using auto generated id
POST favourite_candy/_doc
{
  "first_name": "Jarot",
  "candy": "Kiss"
}

## Create Doc using spesific id 
POST favourite_candy/_doc/1
{
  "first_name": "John",
  "candy": "Relaxa"
}

POST favourite_candy/_doc/2
{
  "first_name": "Rachel",
  "candy": "Granita"
}

POST favourite_candy/_doc/3
{
  "first_name": "Tom",
  "candy": "Aqua"
}

## If id has been created before, then doc will be updated on spesific id, and this not recomended
POST favourite_candy/_doc/3
{
  "first_name": "Jefry",
  "candy": "Snickers"
}

## Read Document
GET favourite_candy/_doc/2

## How to prevent create id without replace if the id has been created before
PUT favourite_candy/_create/3
{
  "first_name": "Jota",
  "candy": "Sugus"
}

## Update field candy on spesific id 2
POST favourite_candy/_update/2
{
  "doc": {
    "candy": "M&M's"
  }
}

## Delete doc from spesific id
DELETE favourite_candy/_doc/3

## Check Document after deleted
GET favourite_candy/_doc/3
